title: Northgate Plus Guarantee — Program Terms
content:
The Plus guarantee of Northgate Memberships is enabled on Northgate Club Plus Membership and Northgate Business Plus Membership.

## 1. The guarantee

On a tier where the Plus guarantee applies, Northgate guarantees that the Annual Reward earned in a membership year is worth at least the tier's Plus premium.

## 2. Recording and confirming a claim

A claim is recorded as a guarantee claim request and takes effect only when the primary member confirms it.

## 3. Claim window

A guarantee claim is accepted only when it is requested no later than the tier's guarantee claim window, in calendar days, after the expiry date of the completed membership year. Days are counted as calendar days, the day after the expiry date being day 1. The window is read from the date of the claim request against the end date of the completed membership year on the membership ledger; the last day of the window is still inside it.

| Completed year ended (hypothetical) | Window | Day 1 | Last day of the window | Request dated | Accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 31 December 2026 | 60 days | 1 January 2027 | 1 March 2027 | 1 March 2027 | Yes |
| 31 December 2026 | 60 days | 1 January 2027 | 1 March 2027 | 2 March 2027 | No |

## 4. Status of the membership

A guarantee claim is paid only on a membership whose status is active or expired.

| Status on the membership record | Guarantee claim paid |
|---|---|
| active | may be paid |
| expired | may be paid |
| suspended | not paid |
| cancelled | not paid |
| closed | not paid |

## 5. One claim per year

Only one guarantee claim is paid per membership year. Once a guarantee refund for a membership year stands on the ledger, a second claim for that same year is not paid; a claim for a different year is judged on its own.

## 6. Certificates already issued

The member keeps any certificate already issued for the completed year.

## 7. Years with no shortfall

A year with reward at or above the Plus premium has no shortfall, and a member who simply wants a cheaper tier without a shortfall downgrades at the next renewal instead.

## Retired clauses — no longer in force

- "For a completed membership year whose Annual Reward is below the Plus premium, the primary member may claim the difference" — **no longer in force**; superseded by the current basis.
- "The refund equals the Plus premium less the Annual Reward of the completed year, is booked as a guarantee refund against the fee charge that paid the Plus premium for that year (the new membership or renewal charge at the Plus tier, or the upgrade difference charge when the year was upgraded mid-term), and goes back to that charge's tender, or to a Northgate Shop Card when the charge was paid with a reward certificate." — **no longer in force**; superseded by the current basis.
- "A confirmed claim moves the membership to its downgrade target tier the same day; when the current membership year has already been paid at the Plus fee, the Plus premium of the current year is also refunded as a downgrade difference against that renewal charge." — **no longer in force**; superseded by the current basis.
